𓁹	<b>eye</b> · D4 · <i>[jr]</i> · eye<br>The eye oversees the doing: in Egypt what the eye watches gets done, and the same sign carries both. See it, and read either sight or work — the two were never far apart.<br><i>msdm,t</i> — "black eye-paint" — kohl (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:VE2JSCEGGZGMZARSXOWKDLNQCY:IBUBdzOum4YRQkH6nXREobm4kNg, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓂞	<b>giving arm</b> · D37 · <i>[dj]</i> · arm handing a loaf<br>The giving arm reaches out with the bread still on it — the moment before the gift lands. Life, health, bread, breath: whatever gods give, this arm is extending it.<br><i>ḏi̯≡f ꜥnḫ-(w)ḏꜣ-snb</i> — "may he give life, prosperity, health" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:HWXOUYTRENGFFMB5KUVYWRHJRY:IBUBd70Q6dj7pkSMoKYTRjTmemM, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓃹	<b>hare</b> · E34 · <i>[wn]</i> · desert hare<br>The hare exists at speed — blink and it is elsewhere, but it IS, emphatically. When Egyptian insists that something exists, endures, will always be, the hare runs through the sentence.<br><i>wnn p,t wnn≡k</i> — "as long as the sky exists, you exist" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:XC6QAUTJCVHPLDGRSYE6AQR4AM:IBUBdzFCWdtW6E0Fmm1Uyep04GU, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓂜	<b>refusal</b> · D35 · <i>[n]</i> · arms spread in refusal<br>Refusal needs no sound: the open arms that mean "nothing here, not happening" in any century. When a sentence opens with this shrug, whatever follows is denied.<br><i>n rdi̯.n≡sn Jmn m jb≡sn</i> — "they did not put Amun in their hearts" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawhistbiospzt:66ATQAWY55BNBFZYHSRGQK5RG4:IBUBd6iYTlk1NUePjd1ybYheCWQ, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓉻	<b>great</b> · O29 · <i>[ꜥꜣ]</i> · wooden column, laid flat<br>Great is a column you could not lift — laid down so you can measure it. Where rank is meant, the swallow flies instead; where sheer size is meant, the column lies here.<br><i>Nfr rn-ꜥꜣ≡f</i> — "Nefer is his great name" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:6CRPOC6MRRG45B75JES3ABTHZE:IBUBd9muUqQ92ErXjUoKSTj9VwE, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓅨	<b>elder</b> · G36 · <i>[wr]</i> · swallow<br>The elder of the air: swallows return each year older and first — the bird of seniority. Mind its lookalike, the sparrow of G37: the swallow's forked tail lifts a word up, the sparrow's round tail drags it down.<br><i>Rꜥw-wr</i> — Ra-wer — "Ra is great" (approximate) (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:3SOT6RKYAJBX7IYKESFMZXREDM:IBUBdyvvHw5gX0VdlhJYRxrccqw, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓇯	<b>sky</b> · N1 · <i>[pt]</i> · sky<br>The sky is a ceiling — Egypt's cosmos was architecture, and this is its lintel. Everything under discussion happens under this slab; gods walk on top of it.<br><i>wnn p,t wnn≡k</i> — "as long as the sky exists, you exist" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:XC6QAUTJCVHPLDGRSYE6AQR4AM:IBUBdzFCWdtW6E0Fmm1Uyep04GU, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓇿	<b>land</b> · N17 · <i>[tꜣ]</i> · flat strip of land<br>The land is a floor as the sky is a ceiling — the world's other slab. 𓄣	<b>heart</b> · F34 · <i>[jb]</i> · heart<br>The heart is a jug with two little handles — pick it up and weigh it, as the gods will. Where we say mind, memory, courage, Egyptian says jb, and draws the organ itself.<br><i>jb≡sn fn ḥr ḏ,t≡sn</i> — "their hearts grow faint in their bodies" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:NW3QVVI5YRAD7F6HR5GGNDDBGA:IBUBdzTaJQptlU2SmbH7WZApCd4, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓏇	<b>likeness</b> · W19 · <i>[mj]</i> · milk jug in a carrying net<br>Likeness travels in the milk jug: milk takes the shape of whatever carries it, and mj pours one thing into another's shape. "You, like Aten" — the jug does the pouring.<br><i>msi̯≡tw≡k mj msi̯.w Jtn</i> — "you are born like Aten is born" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawamarna:XC6QAUTJCVHPLDGRSYE6AQR4AM:IBUBd8adyZ8nckyKkFUqMLPRlds, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓊨	<b>throne</b> · Q1 · <i>[st]</i> · seat, throne<br>The throne fixes a place: to have a seat is to have a station in the world. 𓍑	<b>fire-drill</b> · U28 · <i>[ḏꜣ]</i> · fire-drill<br>The fire-drill spins until the spark takes: prosperity as friction rewarded. 𓈗	<b>water</b> · N35A · <i>[mw]</i> · three ripples of water<br>One ripple is a sound; three ripples are water you could fall into. 𓏱	<b>death's stand-in</b> · Z6 · <i>—</i> · substitute stroke<br>Death's stand-in is the script flinching: the scribes would not draw the corpse, the enemy, the doomed god — so a neutral stroke stands where the danger was. When you meet it, read what was avoided.<br><i>nn rn.pl≡tn</i> — "your names shall not be" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawtempelbib:Q4OD2GDHL5HIXHU3MGUZ3PAMVM:IBUBd5fCxiuh40LfrVMQR1XNMws, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
𓐎	<b>sickness</b> · AA2 · <i>—</i> · pustule (?)<br>Sickness is a swelling drawn small: whatever the little lump once was, the doctors made it their filing mark. In a remedy, the words wearing it are the complaint and its discharges — the reason the papyrus was written.<br><i>dw sjn</i> — "applying the clay" (urn:nabu:aes:bbawgrabinschriften:D6W7KCYSB5BZPNGLGV53DHHC4A:IBUBdxkYkpwLcEhHgGHCQiLfSWE, license: attribution)<br>Edubba · edubba.ac · CC BY-SA 4.0; quoted lines carry their own licenses	edubba edubba-hieroglyphs-102
